transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
China's artificial intelligence compute power is set to double by 2027, confirmed by South China Morning Post, with 65 percent reliant on US chips.
Schwab's promise of Anthropic's Claude for all 16,000 of its registered investment advisors hit a snag when a 20-seat enterprise minimum suddenly sidelined 11,000-plus small firms, still open per RIABiz.
Google is making Gemini smarter behind the wheel by connecting it to Gmail, Photos, and Maps, reported by Yahoo Autos.
OpenAI's bugging case raises questions about artificial intelligence lab security, reported by AZ Family.
Google releases ChromeOS 156 with Gemini Talk to Type dictation and video summaries on Chromebook Plus, reported by gHacks.
Free every hour.
